plan.encoding: ASCII canonical TSV with final LF
plan.repeatable_tail: db2 TAB exact-catalog-name TAB exact-FDID LF; alphabetical names, unique IDs
plan.slopes: integer 0..90; non-steep <= maximum; unselected navigation requires 55/55 and false flags
plan.decryption: required after schema-catalog; disabled or provided-salsa20-v1
plan.collision_storage: optional linux-leased-append-disk-world-v1; if present, all seven downward byte budgets are mandatory; requires vmaps; extract/resume require --scratch

identities.plan: SHA-256 of the complete canonical TSV bytes
identities.source: SHA-256(forever-logical-collection-v1 NUL + build little-endian u32 + build key + CDN key + locale ASCII + ENCODING content key + ROOT content key)
identities.source_scope: authenticated logical collection; not physical archive availability, encryption-key discovery or a complete archive snapshot; every read still requires complete content MD5; provided keys do not change logical content identity; MD5 integrity is not a MAC or trusted provenance
identities.keys: Key names, values, counts, hashes and input paths are excluded from CLI JSON, plans, package context and manifests. Capability is bound by the canonical v4 plan SHA-256; actual keyset is physical availability, not logical collection identity.
identities.schema_catalog: v4 binds the exact schema-catalog id in the canonical plan SHA-256; older plans retain pinned-metadata-v1

db2_raw_text_validation.sections: zero or one supported regular section; sparse and multi-section files excluded
db2_raw_text_validation.trigger: strict row decoding reports invalid_record_string, then complete framing validation is repeated
db2_raw_text_validation.strings: field pointers and NUL terminators must be valid; cumulative source bytes stay within the 64 MiB policy; no UTF-8 conversion or decoded rows are returned
db2_raw_text_validation.output: the complete acquired source DB2 bytes are preserved unchanged

db2_sparse_parent_raw_validation.sections: zero-section empty input or one unencrypted sparse section
db2_sparse_parent_raw_validation.schema: external catalog IDs, no inline ID, appended parent immediately after physical fields
db2_sparse_parent_raw_validation.parent_block: bounded count and exact byte length checked; parent ID and record-index associations are not interpreted
db2_sparse_parent_raw_validation.strings: NUL framing and cumulative source-byte budget checked; no UTF-8 conversion or decoded rows returned
db2_sparse_parent_raw_validation.output: complete acquired source DB2 bytes preserved unchanged
not_claimed: pinned native C++ sparse parent materialization

db2_sparse.schema: external catalog IDs, no inline ID or parent
db2_sparse.fields: U8/U16/U32/I8/I16/I32/F32 and inline UTF-8 string/string arrays
db2_sparse.strings: NUL-terminated within each variable-size sparse record; strict UTF-8

resume: explicit same-context only; verified sealed components skipped; entire unfinished producer reruns and replays retained artifacts; complete output refuses writes; explicit keys are required and syntax/file admission is repeated on each invocation; a different supplied set is allowed, but every unfinished acquired object must still match the same selected complete CKey; sealed producers are verified and skipped
empty_world: complete empty Map direct rows plus validated liquid startup and pure empty navigation plan admit zero navigation artifacts for All only

verification.db2: complete bounded validation against the plan-bound catalog; target profile uses the high-volume reader only for the exact three-table allowlist at one section with schema-declared parent fields and bounded parent entries, the regular-section reader only for admitted 2..16 unencrypted regular sections with external IDs and no parent/TACT/catalog data, and the bounded production sparse subset; strict regular row decoding errors for strings may use the catalog raw-text validator for zero or one regular section, which checks pointers, terminators and byte budgets without UTF-8 conversion or row projection; strict sparse decoding errors for the exact three parent-table allowlist may use the catalog sparse-parent raw validator, which checks bounded record framing and parent-block byte length without projecting rows or parent associations; sectionless zero-row files may carry validated complete column metadata without string/common/pallet payload; exact selected name set
verification.gt: all 20 exact names; 14 numeric, six raw-only
verification.cameras: exact discovered raw file set from selected complete CinematicCamera; no M2 parsing
verification.maps: canonical names, selected map/tile scope, MAPS10/build and tilelist framing
verification.vmaps: VMAP_4.E intrinsic dtree/VMO/tree/tile/index framing and per-tree ordinal bounds
verification.mmaps: canonical selected names, MMAP16/Detour7 framing, no offmesh records
not_claimed: original C++ byte parity for newly produced worlds

failure: stable path-free code and component; incomplete outputs retained; no hidden available-prefix, native, network or missing-file fallback

provided_keys.input: explicit regular file, final symlink and special file rejected; read once with metadata identity and extra-byte EOF check
provided_keys.record_format: forever-tact-keys TAB 1 LF; sorted unique lowercase hex16 u64 name TAB hex32 key LF
provided_keys.cipher: Salsa20/20 with 16-byte keys, nonce4/8 padded to8, frame-index little-endian XOR, initial block counter zero
provided_keys.frames: one E wrapper around N or strict Z only; mandatory complete content MD5 and encoded frame MD5 where framed
provided_keys.source_protection: canonical key-file source included in protected roots before output writes

failure_envelope: forever-product-v4 after valid plan admission; generic CLI/plan failures before admission retain forever-product-v1; all errors path-free
